changes.result: Source slice commit a356fa44 plus follow-up CAS fix f6317184 in crates/herder/src/application/settings.rs. apply_patch now uses only ParsedSettingPatch.revision for the read/CAS; the separate expected_revision argument was removed. RED reproduced accepting parsed revision 1 against current 0 when the caller supplied expected 0; fixed regression now rejects it before save/apply. SettingsPort docs require implementations to serialize revision-read through applied-mark per target across processes and port instances; &mut self alone is explicitly insufficient. Targeted tests pass 7/7. This remains source/fake-port proof only; no production persistence or consumer integration claimed.
